title: In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.6.1, 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17, an unauthenticated user could…
description: Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.6.1, 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17 contain a vulnerability where an unauthenticated user can enumerate valid usernames via the REST API or Splunk Web. This is due to differing login failure responses for locked accounts versus nonexistent usernames. Additionally, repeated login attempts can lock out existing user accounts.
